observations: The notebook randomly selects PE rows without replacement and writes the selected arrays without chain identifiers or original row indices.
The current default sample count is 6000, with selected overrides of 10000; the archived analysis input contains substantially different counts.
This pinned notebook documents an upstream preprocessing convention, not a proven exact generator of every row in the archived PE dictionary.
The archived input is identified independently by docs/analysis/lvk_input_manifest.json. Its physical sample and prior fields do not provide chain identities or effective independent counts.
